visualRisks.description: Water and road colors are very similar, which may cause confusion.
visualRisks.suggestion: Consider using more distinct colors for water and roads.

visualRisks.description: The lighthouse is not easily distinguishable against the ground color.
visualRisks.suggestion: Increase contrast between lighthouse and ground elements.

navigationRisks.description: There are multiple instances where the route path crosses or overlaps, which could be confusing for players.
navigationRisks.suggestion: Ensure that the route does not overlap with itself or other important elements.

navigationRisks.description: The route path includes some diagonal movements that might be difficult to follow on a grid-based layout.
navigationRisks.suggestion: Simplify the route where possible, especially in areas with complex layouts.
